basic_details.job_title: ICAR CCARI Young Professional I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Three Young Professional-I positions paying ₹30,000 per month (fixed) are open at the ICAR-Central Coastal Agricultural Research Institute (ICAR-CCARI), Ela, Old Goa, under the Indian Council of Agricultural Research. One position is reserved for the SC category under the SCSP Fund, one is reserved for the ST category under the STC Fund, and one falls under the Institute Fund. The engagement runs up to 31-03-2027 (extendable). Candidates must hold a bachelor's qualification in the subjects named for each position and be aged 21 to 45 years. If the information in the declaration is found to be incorrect or facts are concealed, the candidature or selection is liable to be cancelled. content_sections.heading: About ICAR-CCARI
content_sections.text: ICAR-Central Coastal Agricultural Research Institute is an institute of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research, located at Ela, Old Goa - 403 402. Its letterhead places it under the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (Department of Agricultural Research and Education), Government of India, and describes it as an ISO 9001:2015 certified institute. The notice invites candidates for hiring technical manpower on a short-term basis at the institute.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice advertises one position in each of three rows, making 3 Young Professional-I positions in all. Each row is funded differently and has its own qualification and duties.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Each position has its own essential qualification. The notice states that the prescribed qualifications are minimum. Young Professional-I (Under SCSP Fund): Master of Fisheries Science (M.F.Sc)/ M.Sc. in Marine Science / Marine Biology Aquaculture. Practical experience in aquaculture, fish breeding data collection, fish sampling and related field work. Knowledge of Hindi/Konkani/ Marathi. Computer proficiency, GIS mapping. Knowledge on Fishing gear operations. Driving knowledge and valid license for two wheeler. Organisation of training and capacity building programme. Video documentation and preparation of blogs, posts, reels, high impact media stories and digital contents. Young Professional-I (Under STC Fund): Master of Science degree in Veterinary Science, Agriculture or allied sciences, Life Sciences; work experience in farm animal research; knowledge and proficiency in statistical methods and computer applications. Young Professional-I (Under Institute Fund): Master of Science degree in Plant Pathology, Agricultural Biotechnology, Biotechnology, and Horticulture sciences; work experience in field experiments; knowledge and proficiency in statistical methods and computer applications. For all three positions, the age limit is Minimum 21, Maximum 45 yrs., relaxable as per rules. The notice does not mention a cut-off date for counting age. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Emoluments: ₹30,000 per month (fixed) for each of the three positions. Duration: up to 31-03-2027, marked "Extendable" in the notice. The appointment is on a full-time basis. A Young Professional is not permitted to take up any other assignment during the period of engagement with ICAR/ICAR Institutes. Notwithstanding the duration of engagement, the Director can terminate the services at any time without assigning any reason by issuing one month's notice or one month's emoluments. A Young Professional may leave on their own volition by giving one month's notice. One month's emoluments will be withheld by the Institute as caution money and released after all dues are cleared. At the end of the assignment, the staff will not have any right to claim employment or engagement at the Institute, and no claim for regular employment at ICAR-CCARI, Ela, Old Goa or any other ICAR Institute.

content_sections.heading: ICAR-CCARI Young Professional-I Job Description
content_sections.text: Young Professional-I (Under SCSP Fund) – nature of duties: Aquaculture field work, fish sampling. Ornamental fish breeding, larval rearing. Fish training, exposure visits and training programmes. Data collection and analysis. Demonstration of fish culture. Recording observations on growth, feeding, water quality analysis. Field visit and fishing-gear-based sampling etc. Video documentation, preparation of social media stories and digital contents. Young Professional-I (Under STC Fund): activities involving farm animal research, field observations and lab analysis, management and handling of animals for collection of biological samples and data, recording of experimental data and biological sample analysis. Young Professional-I (Under Institute Fund): activities involving molecular breeding laboratory work, field observations and lab analysis, management and handling of biological samples and data recording of experimental data.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of an Objective-Type Test of 30-minute duration followed by a structured Interview. Where the number of applications is large, the Institute will restrict the number of candidates after initial screening based on essential and desirable qualification. The Director, ICAR-CCARI, Goa reserves the right to shortlist candidates for the written test/interview on the basis of qualifications, experience etc. Candidates called for the written test/interview are not entitled to TA/DA. The date of the test and interview is not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many Young Professional-I vacancies has ICAR-CCARI announced?
faq.answer: ICAR-CCARI has announced 3 Young Professional-I positions: one reserved for SC (SCSP Fund), one reserved for ST (STC Fund) and one under the Institute Fund.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for ICAR-CCARI Young Professional-I?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Director, ICAR-CCARI, Ela, Old Goa 403 402, on or before 30 November 2026. Late applications, including those delayed in the post, will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for ICAR-CCARI Young Professional-I?
faq.answer: Each position has its own qualification, such as B.F.Sc. or B.Sc. in Marine Science, Fisheries, Aquaculture and related subjects for Post 1, and a Bachelor of science degree in the listed agriculture-related subjects for Posts 2 and 3.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ICAR-CCARI Young Professional-I?
faq.answer: The age limit is minimum 21 and maximum 45 years for all three positions, relaxable as per rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of ICAR-CCARI Young Professional-I?
faq.answer: Each Young Professional-I position carries emoluments of ₹30,000 per month (fixed).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for ICAR-CCARI Young Professional-I?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed proforma, attach a photograph and attested certificates, write the position name on top of the envelope and send it to the Director, ICAR-CCARI, Ela, Old Goa 403 402, so that it reaches by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for ICAR-CCARI Young Professional-I?
faq.answer: Selection consists of an Objective-Type Test of 30-minute duration followed by a structured Interview, after screening of applications.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for more than one Young Professional-I position?
faq.answer: Yes. A separate application form must be submitted for each post, along with the required supporting documents.

faq.question: Q9. Is the ICAR-CCARI Young Professional-I job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is on a short-term, full-time basis up to 31-03-2027 (extendable), and it gives no claim to regular employment at ICAR-CCARI or any other ICAR Institute.

faq.question: Q10. Will ICAR-CCARI pay TA/DA for the test or interview?
faq.answer: No. Candidates called for the written test or interview are not entitled to TA/DA.
